'''Grruna Thu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] and the leader of the [[Shrook Clan]] on [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She once hired the [[Reog's Regiment]] to attack the [[Hakks]], a rival clan, in retaliation for destroying their outpost on [[Gamorr]]. The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were ultimately overwhelmed in the battle.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
